                Synopsis:
                    NFL Hall of Famer Emmitt Smith and business partner David Mosley face a lawsuit in Delaware's Chancery Court filed by Kituwah LLC (Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians). Kituwah alleges their $2.5M loan for a Texas solar project ("Project Exodus") was misappropriated — redirected to pay off Wilson Holdings in what the suit describes as a Ponzi-like scheme. The loan, due February 1, 2024, remains fully unpaid. Claims include fraudulent inducement, breach of fiduciary duty, and breach of contract. Plaintiff seeks $2.5M+ in damages, interest, and attorney fees.
